LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 9.1.2 NEWS TELLING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.1: Observing and Articulating signs 9.1.2 News telling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs 9.1.2 News telling, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do people move from one place to another? 2. What happens when one is travelling?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs 9.1.2 News telling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Unity: non-discrimination as learners discuss and all appreciate diversity in means of transport and the fact that some

cannot be found in different areas due to different factors.

● Responsibility: accountability as learner is cautioned to observe road safety when using, boarding and alighting from

a means of transport.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Financial literacy as learner tell news on what happens when travelling, talks about payment of fare so as to travel from

one point to another.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Learner relates sign singing songs and signing poems related to means of transport with sign singing in Creative

activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Adapted course books, Signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures, online resources, relevant digital

devices.
